changes.evidence: What If...? episode 2: Carina starts the episode as the Collector's slave/assistant in his museum on Knowhere. She turns on him by shooting Ebony Maw to free T'Challa, then uses the Collector's bracelet to free his captives. The wiki lists the Tivan Group as a former affiliation, and she joins no other group.

What If...? episode 11: Hank used to work for S.H.I.E.L.D. but left the agency after Janet disappeared, before the episode starts ('Used to work, sweetie. Not anymore.'). In the episode Howard Stark calls him in to join the Avengers team that S.H.I.E.L.D. puts together, and Peggy and Howard brief it. The wiki lists S.H.I.E.L.D. only as a former affiliation and the Avengers as his current one. He does not rejoin the agency itself.

owner_calls.question: In What If...? S3 Uatu is put on trial and held by the Order of the Watchers. The Guardians of the Multiverse rescue him, and he leads them into battle against his 'former masters'. The Order is then stripped of its powers, and Uatu goes on watching with Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm. Does this count as leaving the Watchers' group or joining the Guardians?
options: Keep [["The Watchers", "(from the start)"]] (he is still a Watcher; the trial was held by his own group)
[["The Watchers", "What If...? S1"], ["Guardians of the Multiverse", "What If...? S3"]]
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki infobox: 'Order of the Watchers (formerly), Cosmic Entities'. Its biography says he was 'rescued by the new Guardians of the Multiverse... leading to a battle between the Watchers and the Guardians. Reclaiming his identity as Uatu, Watcher turned the Guardians into fellow Watchers.' Wikipedia's summary of S3 episode 8 says the same.

owner_calls.question: In the What If...? S3 finale Uatu gives the Guardians Watcher powers. After Carter's sacrifice he invites Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm to join him in watching over the multiverse. Is that a move into The Watchers?
options: Keep [["Mohawk", "What If...? S2"], ["Guardians of the Multiverse", "What If...? S3"]]
[["Mohawk", "What If...? S2"], ["Guardians of the Multiverse", "What If...? S3"], ["The Watchers", "What If...? S3"]]

options: Keep [["Guardians of the Multiverse", "(from the start)"]]

owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia S3 episode 8: 'the Watcher invites Kahhori, Byrdie, and Storm to join him in watching over the multiverse.' The MCU wiki infobox lists only Guardians of the Multiverse.

owner_calls.question: In What If...? episode 1 Steve is presumed dead in the train explosion, but HYDRA actually captures him and holds him at Castle de Krake. Bucky and the Howling Commandos free him later in the same episode, and he fights on with them. Should this short captivity be recorded as a stage? The twin T:by-hydra-stomper has the same groups. Episode 2 has the same pattern: the Collector briefly jails Yondu and Thanos (A:by-yondu-tchalla, A:by-thanos-ravager) as part of a staged triple-cross, and both are free again within minutes. I left those unchanged.
options: Keep (captivity begins and ends inside the same episode)
